newsitem.title: UK: RUGBY UNION-LIONS SEEK SAFETY IN NUMBERS.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-LIONS SEEK SAFETY IN NUMBERS.

text.p: Lions manager Fran Cotton intends to take an enlarged squad of 35 players to South Africa next year to ensure extra back-up and avoid having to fly out replacements during the tour.

Cotton and coach Ian McGeechan were both on Lions tours which regularly drafted in new players and can also draw on their experience as members of the 1974 squad who were the only Lions team to win a series in the Republic.

"It is essential we are able to field sides of test-match strength throughout the tour," said Cotton, who has just returned from a 10-day fact-finding trip to prepare for the 13-match tour. "Our plan is to take two full teams, plus additional men in key positions; hooker, prop, back-five forward, centre/wing and scrum-half."

The squad will be attended by a similarly expanded 10-man management, coaching and medical team. "Our intention is to match the World Cup holders in every facet of the game," said Cotton, who will announce the squad at the end of March.
